authorization: User requested three primitive tasks including jump, a composite with obstacle avoidance then elevated treasure contact, one color pair, and stopping v0.9 to switch. User subsequently approved the wider preview for composite training: 24m floor and player start 4m farther from treasure. User additionally requested R: random shared encoder frozen, new heads trained.
success_condition: avoid obstacle collision, jump onto platform, land, then contact treasure while on platform

condition_definitions.P: pretrained shared encoder frozen; new actor and critic heads trained
condition_definitions.S: random shared encoder; new actor and critic heads; all trained
condition_definitions.F: pretrained shared encoder unfrozen; new actor and critic heads; all trained
condition_definitions.R: random shared encoder frozen; new actor and critic trained

source_seed_policy: P and F use the primitive model from the matching seed

matching.new_heads: same initial actor and critic weights for P, S, F, R within each seed
matching.random_shared: R and S share identical random initial shared encoder weights for the matching seed

training_success_denominator: sum successes + failures + interruptions over unique updates; exclude unfinished episodes and discarded surplus transitions
start_gate: All 3 seeds finish 2000 updates, deterministic validation of all 3 tasks (36 episodes each), and primitive processes exit.
appearance: target and platform orange / avatar cyan in all tasks
primitive_head_transfer: Discard all 3 primitive actor/critic pairs; transfer only shared encoder
